meta.title: Copper Wire
meta.key: A pedal, suspended; breakdown Fmaj7#11, Gsus2, Dsus2, E7sus
meta.words: v3: the steel drum is now the native one (a pan's note computed from its physics), and a bell cloud blooms through the breakdown; otherwise as v2. v2, from your notes: the pad pumps and moves, drifting through suspended chords over the A that never resolve; the breakdown leaves the A for a progression that hangs on a suspended E until the drop; the bass grows from the intro's notes into the riff a few at a time and keeps evolving; the steel drum and the ping bloom under automation (filters, resonance, speeding LFOs, echo washes, reverb throws), and the ping grows from one note into a phrase.
